decisions.reason: The single-tube air fin cooler sits close to the core air-cooling offer and has been publicly listed for two years, so management still reads any slow uptake as ramp-up and stays committed.
The air cooled condenser supports the announced efficiency and air-cooling direction, and the engineering already invested leads management to persist.

Despite overlapping with Product B, management justifies the condenser as serving distinct applications and keeps it rather than admit the duplication was a mistake, though it remains the most exposed product.
The tube liner reinforces the lifecycle service business the firm emphasizes, so management keeps it despite the earlier withdrawal of the similar repair inserts.
The multi-model customized air cooler line embodies the firm's core promise of customized integrated solutions and carries the heaviest investment, so dropping it is very unlikely.
